types.Id: Opaque string; preserve existing UUID/content identity; never generate identity from display name
types.NativeId: Opaque nonempty provider string, namespace-qualified; never round through a JavaScript number
types.Instant: UTC ISO 8601 string ending Z; database time evaluates deadlines; unknown source times stay null
types.Revision: Nonnegative integer serialized as decimal string when crossing the safe-integer boundary
types.Field<T>: {state: known|empty|absent|null|invalid, value: T|null}; absent/null/invalid have null value; empty requires explicit source evidence
types.Ref: Id of retained immutable evidence; reference must resolve in the same audience and declared scope
types.Json: Retained native JSON; shared readers consume normalized fields, not raw provider-specific paths
types.IdentityLookupScope: {kind:'identity-lookup', provider:string, lookupRequestId:Id, accessContextId:Id, audienceId:Id, coverageSpecId:Id}; capture-only before stable account resolution; no league or source mapping required; request ID prevents renamed/reassigned usernames merging evidence
types.AccountResourceScope: {kind:'account-resource', provider:string, providerAccountId:Id, nativeAccountId:NativeId, family:'league-discovery', sport:'nfl', season:integer, accessContextId:Id, audienceId:Id, coverageSpecId:Id}; account IDs must agree; one exact season per list receipt; no invented league ID
types.EvidenceCoverage: {coverageSpecId:Id, observed:ObservedCoverage, populationEvidenceRef:Ref|null, roleGroups:{seasonTeamId:Id,primary:'known'|'unknown',coManagers:'known'|'unknown'}[]}; reuse ObservedCoverage from apps/site/lib/aggregator/contracts.ts; [] means not applicable or no qualified rows, never exhaustive removal without population and role qualification
types.DependencyRef: {kind:'actor'|'session'|'association'|'acquisition-context'|'source-mapping'|'current-selection'|'membership'|'policy'|'preference'|'serving-selection', id:Id, revision:Revision|string}; exact relevant vector, not arbitrary free-form claims; evaluated against authoritative current dependencies
types.ProviderManagerIdentity: Reuse apps/site/lib/aggregator/team-managers.ts: {providerManagerId:Id,sourceManager:ProviderReference}. providerManagerId resolves ProviderAccount.id; sourceManager.nativeId is the exact provider key, not the internal UUID; provider/namespace/native key must match that account.
